newsitem.title: USA: Guarantee Life says will run buy-back plan.
newsitem.headline: Guarantee Life says will run buy-back plan.

text.p: The Guarantee Life Cos Inc said Tuesday it plans to buy back stock from shareholders who own fewer than 100 shares in order to cut its administrative costs.
The company said that under the terms of the program, Guarantee Life can buy up to $20 million of its common stock, or 10 percent of the outstanding shares, whichever is less.
The company said Shareholders Communications Corp will administer the program, which is scheduled for April 28 through May 29.

The company said shareholders who participate will receive a price per share equal to the average closing market price reported by Nasdaq for it's common stock for the trading days between April 28 and May 29.
The company said a processing fee of $0.85 will be deducted from each participating shareholder's proceeds in order to defray the cost of the program.
To be eligible the shareholders must be individuals who owned fewer than 100 shares of common stock as of April 16.
